extraction_notes: Verified the supplied PDF SHA-256 as dd6685a75cdccbe3a6a290f916cb29ad27e9252703862dc167c4967c2ff12bf4.
The forward-voltage plot is a typical grouped curve SS28-SS210 rather than an SS210-only trace; the digitized points retain the plotted axes and conditions.

The reverse-characteristics plot is a typical grouped curve SS28-SS220; the lower dashed Tj = 25 degC trace was used and the x-axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage. For SS210, 100% corresponds to 100 V VRRM.

The electrical table gives SS210 a maximum forward voltage of 0.85 V at IF = 2.0 A and a maximum reverse current of 0.05 mA at rated DC blocking voltage at Ta = 25 degC. The separate 100 degC reverse-current row is 10 mA and is not the primary room-temperature leakage input.
The typical junction capacitance is 300 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz for the SS28-SS220 group including SS210.
The examined datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification and no breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification.
omission_reason: No reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage/current specification is published; no capacitance-versus-reverse-bias curve is provided, only one tabulated capacitance point.
